title: LPC to LSF/LSP Conversion
text: Convert linear prediction coefficients to line spectral pairs or line spectral frequencies, 1 input, 4 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Output} sets Conversion output LSP in range; {Root finding coarse grid points} sets the number of search steps, {Root finding bisection refinement} sets the number of bisections, {Show output validity status} shows status of output validity, {If current output is invalid, overwrite with previous output} sets the overwrite invalid outputs with previous, {When first output is invalid, overwrite with user-defined values} sets the overwrite invalid first output with user-defined, {User-defined LSP/LSF values for overwriting invalid first output} sets the user-defined LSP/LSF values and {If first input value is not 1} sets the action to take if first input value is not. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Linear prediction coefficients column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSP
ports.summary: Line spectral pairs column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSFn
ports.summary: Line spectral frequencies normalized in range (0 0.5) column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSFr
ports.summary: Line spectral frequencies in range (0 π) column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Validity status of output scalar | row vector

params.name: Output
params.values: Conversion output LSP in range (-1 1) (default) | LSF normalized in range (0 0.5) | LSF in range (0 pi)

params.name: Root finding coarse grid points
params.values: Number of search steps 64 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Show output validity status
params.values: Show status of output validity off (default) | on

params.name: If current output is invalid, overwrite with previous output
params.values: Overwrite invalid outputs with previous output off (default) | on

params.name: When first output is invalid, overwrite with user-defined values
params.values: Overwrite invalid first output with user-defined values off (default) | on

params.name: User-defined LSP/LSF values for overwriting invalid first output
If first input value is not 1
params.values: Action to take if first input value is not 1 Ignore (default) | Normalize | Normalize and warn | Error
